title: Fire and Security Integrators: Align Salesforce Installed Equipment With NetSuite Customer and Service Records
summary: Connect installed fire and security asset context to customer and service records without losing device identity.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Fire, life-safety and security integrators need persistent installed-equipment identities across sales, service and billing. Salesforce–NetSuite two-way sync can connect accessible asset or approved custom records to the correct customer, site and service context. Preserve device identifiers and installation relationships separately from the payer. The sync provides administrative continuity; it does not certify inspection results or prove that a device is suitable for a particular application. Validate the selected objects and writes before enabling changes.


Explore the complete[fire, life-safety and security integrators integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fire-life-safety-security-integrators) for the systems and processes around this guide.
